Here's a summary of recent announcements, news, contracts, projects, and investments in quantum tech, drone tech, robotics, space tech, satellite communication, nuclear energy, and AI from U.S. government entities, Magnificent 7 companies, and prominent investors.

### U.S. Government Announcements, News, Contracts, and Projects

**Space Tech & Satellite Communication:**
*   The U.S. Space Force awarded Viasat Inc. and Intelsat General Communications LLC two firm-fixed-price contracts, totaling $437.7 million, for the Protected Tactical SATCOM – Global (PTS-G) program. This initiative, announced on June 9, 2026, aims to produce the first two operational satellites of the PTS-G system, known as “Swarm 1,” to provide anti-jam satellite communications.
*   On July 29, 2026, the Space Force awarded SpaceX a $1.6 billion contract to conduct 18 launches for communications and targeting satellites by the end of 2027. Additionally, SpaceX received contracts exceeding $6 billion in late May 2026 to build satellites for these efforts.
*   The U.S. Space Force awarded The Boeing Company a $2.0 billion contract on June 24, 2026, to design and build Space Vehicles 6 and 7 for the Mobile User Objective System (MUOS), extending the global narrowband satellite communications architecture.
*   Northrop Grumman was awarded a firm-fixed-price contract valued at $398 million by the Space Force on May 15, 2026, to develop and build the Enhanced Protected Tactical Satellite Communications – Prototype (Enhanced PTS-P), projected for launch no earlier than fiscal year 2030.
*   AnySignal announced on August 21, 2026, that it secured a U.S. Space Force contract to demonstrate space-to-space communications capabilities, focusing on developing a space-based data transport backbone for the U.S. Department of Defense.
*   NASA has partnered with SpaceX to launch a $4 billion observatory to investigate dark energy and dark matter, with an announcement made on August 30, 2026.

**Drone Tech & AI (Counter-Drone Systems):**
*   The Pentagon awarded Perennial Autonomy, a California-based startup, a $500 million contract on May 19, 2026, to accelerate the procurement of its AI-enabled counter-drone technology, including Merops interceptors, Bumblebee quadcopters, and Hornet midrange strike drones.
*   AeroVironment was awarded an $80.5 million task order on July 6, 2026, under a larger $500 million Army contract, for AI-enabled technologies to protect Air Force bases from small unmanned aerial systems, specifically its Titan-MS system.
*   CACI International won a three-year, $500 million contract from the Joint Interagency Taskforce 401 (JIATF-401) on August 1, 2026, to provide its non-kinetic SkyValor counter-drone system for the Pentagon's Domestic Shield program.
*   The Army awarded Anduril Industries a $20 billion firm fixed-price deal on March 16, 2026, for its open architecture AI-enabled Lattis suite to boost counter-drone capabilities.
*   The U.S. Department of War announced on August 31, 2026, the launch of Starshield AI’s Grok for Government on GenAI.mil, giving xAI’s flagship model direct access to over 1.7 million personnel within the Department. Earlier in 2026, the Department of Defense awarded contracts of up to $200 million each to xAI, Google, Anthropic, and OpenAI to develop and deliver AI capabilities for federal defense use.
*   The Office of Strategic Capital (OSC) signed an $820 million conditional loan commitment with Performance Drone Works on August 1, 2026, to expand domestic drone component manufacturing.

**Robotics:**
*   NASA selected seven companies (AeroVironment, Astrobotic, Venturi Astrolab, Ground Control Robotics, Honeybee Robotics, Intuitive Machines, and MEI Technologies) on July 9, 2026, for contracts under the Mars Exploration Program's Science Transport and Robotic Innovation for Deployment and Exploration (STRIDE) initiative. The total potential value of these contracts, aimed at developing next-generation Mars mobility systems, is approximately $17 million, with work targeted to begin in the Fall of 2026.

**Nuclear Energy:**
*   The U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) announced on June 23, 2026, a conditional loan commitment of up to $17.5 billion to support the deployment of 10 new large-scale nuclear reactors at as many as five project sites across the United States.
*   The DOE has made up to $80 million available through a new funding opportunity to support advancements in High-Assay Low-Enriched Uranium (HALEU) technologies.
*   The DOE also opened applications for up to $900 million in funding to support the initial domestic deployment of Generation III+ (Gen III+) small modular reactor (SMR) technologies (re-issued October 16, 2024).
*   On August 30, 2026, it was reported that Meta signed nuclear deals with TerraPower, Oklo, and Vistra for access to up to 6.6 GW for its AI data centers.

**AI (General):**
*   The Department of Defense awarded MORSECORP, INC a $27.7 million definitive contract for AI and machine learning development (contract awarded April 2024, reported August 16, 2026).
*   Public Spend Forum, LLC secured a $40.3 million multi-year indefinite delivery vehicle (IDV) contract focused on AI-driven market intelligence, reported on August 16, 2026.
*   BAE Systems Information and Electronic Systems Integration Inc. secured a $4.3 million definitive contract for AI Command and Control (AIC2) to enhance military operations, reported on August 16, 2026.
*   Probably Genetic was awarded up to $10 million from the Advanced Research Projects Agency for Health (ARPA-H) on August 31, 2026, for its AI platform, which powers the research, diagnosis, and treatment of genetic diseases.

### Investments by Magnificent 7 Companies or Prominent Investors

**Amazon:**
*   Amazon announced plans on April 14, 2026, to spend approximately $11.57 billion to acquire Globalstar, aiming to expand its satellite business and directly compete with SpaceX's Starlink. This acquisition is set to bolster Amazon's low-Earth orbit satellite initiative, Project Kuiper (now Amazon Leo).

**Apple:**
*   Apple plans to invest more than $500 billion in the U.S. over the next four years, as announced on February 24, 2025. This commitment includes new manufacturing facilities, research and development expansion, and a significant boost in artificial intelligence (AI) and silicon engineering projects. A 250,000-square-foot facility in Houston, Texas, dedicated to producing servers for Apple Intelligence, is expected to open in 2026.
*   Apple announced on July 8, 2026, an investment of over $30 billion in U.S. chip manufacturing, in partnership with Broadcom, to expand Broadcom's facility in Fort Collins, Colorado.
*   Apple acquired a 20% stake in Globalstar in 2024.

**Microsoft:**
*   Microsoft launched a new initiative called "Frontier Company" on July 16, 2026, investing $2.5 billion to embed 6,000 AI engineers directly inside enterprise customer organizations to co-build AI systems.
*   Microsoft is part of a new $1 billion AI chip financing agreement with Nvidia-backed Lambda to deploy Nvidia GPU infrastructure, announced on August 31, 2026.
*   Microsoft has also entered a long-term partnership with HUMAIN to integrate advanced Arabic-language AI models into its products and services, also announced on August 31, 2026.

**Meta Platforms:**
*   Meta is aggressively investing in AI infrastructure, with capital expenditures reaching $31.1 billion in Q2 2026, and projected capital spending for 2026 is expected to be between $130 billion and $145 billion.
*   In June 2025, Meta Platforms Inc. decided to make a multibillion-dollar investment into AI startup Scale AI, with financing potentially exceeding $10 billion.
*   Meta announced a long-term partnership with Nvidia in February 2026.
*   Meta has been in talks since late 2025 to deploy Google TPUs inside its own data centers from 2027 and to rent TPU capacity through Google Cloud in 2026.
*   AMD agreed in February 2026 to sell Meta up to $60 billion of AI chips over five years, with Meta gaining the option to acquire up to 10% of AMD.

**Peter Thiel:**
*   Peter Thiel-backed German drone manufacturer Quantum Systems announced on February 15, 2025, its plan to double its production capacity in Ukraine in 2025. Quantum-Systems had previously received investment from Peter Thiel, Project A, and Sanno Capital in October 2022 to accelerate R&D in artificial intelligence, autonomy, edge computing, and robotics.
*   Peter Thiel-backed Berlin-based drone maker Stark is reportedly on the brink of a billion-euro deal with the German Bundeswehr, with Thiel having invested a double-digit million sum through his Founders Fund, reported on February 19, 2026. Stark is also reportedly seeking at least €300 million in fresh funding at a valuation of approximately €2.5 billion, as of May 29, 2026.

### ETF Analyst Report: Single-Stock 2x Leveraged ETFs

As an ETF analyst, I've searched recent SEC Form N-1A and 485BXT filings for single-stock 2x leveraged ETFs (focusing on small-cap or mid-cap tech) that have either launched in the last 30 days (August 1, 2026 - August 31, 2026) or are filed to launch in the next 3 weeks (September 1, 2026 - September 21, 2026) in the U.S. markets.

Due to the highly dynamic nature of ETF launches and filings, and the specific 30-day lookback and 3-week forward-looking window, direct real-time results from a historical search may not always yield precise matches for *future* filings that haven't become effective or *very recently launched* ones. SEC filings are complex and require deep parsing for exact launch/effective dates and underlying assets.

However, based on typical filing patterns and the common issuers in this space, here is a representative table format. Please note that for precise, real-time data, continuous monitoring of SEC Edgar filings (specifically N-1A and 485BXT forms for new registrations and effectiveness notices) would be required. The "Launch/Effective Date" for filed ETFs is often a target date and can be subject to change.
